text.tspan: The Falcon030 parallel port has been extended from previous TOS
products, to include two additional signals - 'Acknowledge', and
The new parallel port now looks like this:
'Acknowledge' is an input, active low from the printer. It is
connected to the MFP pin GPIP1.
'Select' is an output, normally used to turn a printer on-line. It is
connected to the PSG pin IOA3.
